title: English - Linguistics Option
sourceText:
Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

Humanities [HUM]

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

Electives
Electives: Students in this major are encouraged to pursue a second major, minor, or certificate and should speak to their advisor about complementary options. May need to include one [M] course to meet University requirements of two total writing in the major courses.

Communication [COMM] or Written Communication [WRTG]

ENGLISH/ANTH 256 [SSCI]

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

Arts [ARTS]

Diversity [DIVR]

Linguistics MATH, CPT S, PSYCH, or STAT Elective
Linguistics MATH, CPT S, PSYCH, or STAT Electives: a minimum of 3 credits selected from CPT S 111, 121, 440, 443, MATH 140, 171, 172, 182, 202, 273, 283, PSYCH 311, STAT 212, 360, 443.

Linguistics PHIL Elective
Linguistics PHIL Electives: Minimum of 3 credits in PHIL 201, 401, 443, 499.

Foreign Language, if needed, or Elective
Electives: Students in this major are encouraged to pursue a second major, minor, or certificate and should speak to their advisor about complementary options. May need to include one [M] course to meet University requirements of two total writing in the major courses.
Two years of high school foreign language or at least two semesters of college-level foreign language are required by the College of Arts and Sciences for graduation.

ENGLISH 444

Equity and Justice [EQJS]

Linguistics Core Electives
Linguistics Core Electives: minimum of 6 credits to be selected from ENGLISH 112, 454, 458, or 499.

Complete University Writing Portfolio

ENGLISH 456 [M]

300-400-level Foreign Language Elective
Linguistics Foreign Language Electives: minimum of 6 credits in upper division language courses selected from CHINESE, FRENCH, GERMAN, JAPANESE, or SPANISH.

Linguistics Emphasis Elective
Linguistics Emphasis Electives: minimum of 12 credits in an area of emphasis and chosen in consultation with an advisor to include sufficient 300-400-level coursework to meet the 40-credit University requirements. Approved courses include any unused Linguistics Elective or Linguistics Core Elective, COM 321, 421, any unused Foreign Language Elective course, PSYCH 490, 492, TCH LRN 333, and TCH LRN 414.

ENGLISH 443

Complete Exit Survey

ENGLISH 457

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

300-400-level Electives
Electives: Students in this major are encouraged to pursue a second major, minor, or certificate and should speak to their advisor about complementary options. May need to include one [M] course to meet University requirements of two total writing in the major courses.

A student may be admitted to the English – Linguistics Option upon making their intention known to the department.

Requirements for this degree include 45 credits: 15 credits of Linguistics core courses, 6 credits of Linguistics core electives, 12 credits of Linguistics emphasis electives, and the remaining 12 credits from a set of option-specific electives variously distributed depending on the special emphasis selected by the student and their advisor.
